Energy Saver vocabulary — what translates differently in zh-Hans

MDM Energy Saver marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general localization guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate macOS power-management policy — not a literal paste of US marketing:

节能 (Energy Saver)

Enterprise MDM marketing uses 节能 alongside the English term Energy Saver when describing MDM-configured power-management policy on enrolled fleet Macs. AppLocale picks phrasing buyers recognize on each screenshot — a display sleep slider needs 节能-friendly headlines; a technical badge may keep Energy Saver when accurate to your English source.

节能偏好 (Energy Saver preferences)

When MDM workflows mirror macOS Energy Saver preference panels, zh-Hans enterprise docs use 节能偏好. Use when your gallery shows Energy Saver policy editors, com.apple.PowerManagement payload panels, or "Energy Saver preferences" overlays — distinct from 登录窗口 Login Window vocabulary for login-screen policy.

When marketing frames emphasize fleet-wide sleep and wake governance, use 电源管理 on admin-console frames showing "Power management", "MDM power policy", or organization energy posture dashboards. Distinct from battery-health consumer vocabulary unless your frame shows Battery Health UI specifically.

Wake for network access / scheduled power / prevent sleep when display is off

Technical mockups may reference wake for network access, schedule power on or off, or prevent computer from sleeping when display is off on policy editor frames.
